name: gradient-midnight-bloom
blurb: Deep blue to dark magenta gradient.
description: A linear gradient from deep midnight blue to dark magenta. Renders as a styled div with the gradient applied as a background.
use_when: Dark, elegant backgrounds for premium or moody sections.
avoid_when: Light-themed interfaces or content requiring high contrast.
a11y: Wrapper only; decorative background gradient with no interactive elements.
